text: Stewie, what's exponential? Sounds like a fancy sandwich.
Please, you walking meatball; exponential means doubling, fast.
Doubling like my snacks during commercials?
Exactly—1, 2, 4, 8—soon your pantry files a noise complaint.
Linear's like steps on a staircase, right? One at a time.
Yes, exponential is an elevator rocketing past the roof.
Fold a paper 42 times—thickness reaches the moon. Ish.
My hands can’t even fold my laundry once.
Tragic. Also why compound interest loves patient people.
Bingo. Tiny doubles turn into tidal waves.
Then why do graphs start flat?
Early doubles look boring; then kaboom—the curve goes vertical.
Don’t fear small beginnings—steady doubling outruns big single steps.
Alright, professor—show me more math that cheats time?
